cases.paper_identifier: PeerRead ACL 2017 submission 68: A New Formula for Vietnamese Text Readability Assessment
cases.version: Archived ACL submission PDF, PeerRead revision 9bb37751781a900cee9e74ec3105997732c8e8e5; not a later published version
cases.permission: ACL 2017 collection CC BY 4.0; attribution: Kang et al., A Dataset of Peer Reviews (PeerRead), NAACL 2018. Local evaluation; no PDF/review redistribution.
cases.question: Assess the experimental support and clarity of this paper. Identify concrete missing details or unsupported comparisons using only the paper.
cases.version_match_basis: PeerRead archives the submission draft and corresponding reviews under the same ACL 2017 ID 68 at a pinned commit. Review 2 quotes the 81% accuracy and practical-use claim found together on physical page 6; review 2 describes the three-class corpus on page 3. This is archival pairing plus content cross-checking, not an OpenReview revision-history audit.

known_issues.description: The evaluation lacks accuracy comparisons with existing readability formulas, leaving the relative benefit of the proposed formula unclear.
known_issues.provenance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allenai/PeerRead/9bb37751781a900cee9e74ec3105997732c8e8e5/data/acl_2017/train/reviews/68.json#/reviews/2/comments; reviewer asks for accuracy of existing formulas and comparative pros/cons.
known_issues.review_quote:
the experimental section lacks comparisons with previous work and
analysis of results.
known_issues.match_criteria: Explicitly identify missing comparable baseline/readability-formula results or inability to establish relative performance. Generic requests for more experiments do not suffice.

passages.quote:
81%. This is a good result and can be applied in
practice.

known_issues.description: The approach used to identify multi-syllable Vietnamese words, and its accuracy, is not specified clearly.
known_issues.provenance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/allenai/PeerRead/9bb37751781a900cee9e74ec3105997732c8e8e5/data/acl_2017/train/reviews/68.json#/reviews/2/comments; reviewer asks how syllables are merged into words and with what accuracy.
known_issues.review_quote:
Do they use a particular approach for
merging syllables?
known_issues.match_criteria: Identify unspecified word segmentation/tokenization or syllable-to-word merging and its consequences for word-count/readability features. Merely explaining Vietnamese syllables is not a match.
